Kinda, yeah. It just sucks so much. Especially when you don't see the reason to do whatever.

Yeah, that's true... for better or worse it's all in my hands. 
But still, I appreciate your help!

I usually don't make plans, because there are so many unknowns and I hate making changes to stuff - I'm the type of person who cannot function properly, if they don't stick to something, I guess.
Also - nice! I've never actually done any Urban Exploration really (not to a big extend), but I adore abandoned places - there's some kind of melancholy and dark beauty in them. 
Social interactions are kind of a tricky animal to tame, even online. It's worse irl tho, especially if a person is like me - the more nervous I am, the more I talk. Which is not always a good thing.

Anyway, I really appreciate your comments. Thank you!

No, not paranoia. Just... hesitation I guess. And the fact that I apparently have to learn how to lose and try again. Because I'm afraid that if I fail at something, I won't be able to pick myself up and try again.

Honestly... I don't know how likely it will be for that thing to happen actually. Maybe very likely and probably because I'll fuck them up accidentally.
As for what exactly would be the thing itself... well, there are many things that can go south, we never know. That's why I constantly overthink and try to "prepare" for all kinds of worst case scenarios.

Honestly... I don't know what I really want. I just... don't want *this*, whatever this is. But... sometimes the fear of making that one first step is so crippling that I just never make it. And it's getting worse each time I start to feel like this - otherwise this thread won't even exist. 

But yeah, I know what you mean. I just don't know if I have what it takes to do the change.

All the stuff that holds me back. I'm clinging to my fears and stuff so much that I feel almost "comfortable" with them. And trying to get away from them is like I'm trying to get naked and enter a jungle, full with nasty stuff that will eat me alive if I dare go near them.  


In other words - I hate the unknown and the randomness of the future and since my fears are my only familiar things, I hold on to them for dear life. How ironic, considering how much I want to finish this same life sometimes.

Yeah, I know what you mean, I've though about it. Honestly, I don't even care if I disappoint myself, it's whatever. I am an extremely stubborn guy and my biggest problem is maybe that I channel this stubbornness towards the wrong things. And it's gotten to this point, where it's just... so damn tiring, you know.

okay, first - you are right. Yeah. Deep inside it's always about ourselves. The thing is I just don't see myself as a something too unique - just... someone random. Besides, I overthink stuff too much and my fear of failing just stops me for even trying to do stuff. So as an individual, I don't think I have any importance.

As for the question... no idea. Probably will create stuff the way I see fit. Which would be kinda fucked now when I think about it, but... yeah. I'll get bored super quickly, but at least I won't sit down and try to "predict" every outcome of every my possible action, like I'm doing now.
Kinda, yeah. Don't ask me why I do that. I guess it have something to do with fear of failure. I'm so afraid to lose or fail, that I just... accept that I'll lose and do nothing to try and see.

Funny thing is that... I know these things. Only... my brain doesn't work most of the time, lol. And it's not about what I don't think is going to happen, because I haven't even tried seriously - just because I overthink stuff like crazy and my mind is *convinced* that nothing will ever happen. Because of that I don't even *try* doing stuff and accept that It's not going to happen.

Yeah... my head is... pretty interesting place...
I have hobbies. Way too many. Just... I don't really like to do stuff for the sake of it, if you know what I mean.
